evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries high-arousal urgency to purge information, a forceful directive registering alarm-level insistence.
The absolutist 'all knowledge' amplifies the directive's urgency beyond routine instruction into insistent erasure-demand, high-arousal negative valence.
Flat declarative closing assertion delivered without intensifiers or urgency — resigned, low-arousal negation settling the matter.
